title: Coupon
description: Coupons describe voucher alike commerce capabilities.

discountType.description: `PERCENT` for relative values, `ABSOLUTE` for float values, referring to a specific currency, `FREE_SHIPPING` for reducing the shipping cost to 0.

discountPercentage.description: A discount percentage within the range [0.00, 100.00]. Must be specified only if type is `PERCENT`.

allowAnonymous.description: Specifies if the coupon can be redeemed by anonymous users.

maxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: Maximum number of redemptions per customer; -1 designates 'unlimited'. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

validFor.description: A list of customer identifiers for whom the coupon can be redeemed. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

validFrom.description: Must be provided in ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'

validUntil.description: Must be provided in ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'

issuedTo.description: The Id of the customer who originally received the coupon (seller-only).

redemptionCount.description: The number of times a specific coupon has been redeemed. Read-only, set through server (seller-only).

status.description: Current status of the coupon (read-only). `INACTIVE`: the coupon is only valid in the future; `VALID`: can be used; `EXPIRED`: the coupon validity period has expired; `USED`: the maximum number of redemptions for the coupon has been reached.

deleted.description: Flag to mark a coupon as deleted (a.k.a. Soft delete). It is a read-only and seller-only attribute

version.description: Version of the document. Set to 0 after creating a document. Increments by 1 after every update.

currency-amount.title: Money amount
currency-amount.description: Defines an amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Total amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF.

referralCouponProperty.description: Indicates if the coupon is type of referral coupon. This property is read only.
